quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Night to make your room dark and cozy for sleeping"?
quests.question: Turn Off the Light
quests.hint: A small switch on the wall helps with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We turn off the light at night to make our room cozy for sleep.
quests.funFact: A dark room can help your body understand that it's time to sleep!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to put your clothes away neatly instead of on the floor"?
quests.question: Hang Up Clothes
quests.hint: A hook or a hanger is where these end up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We hang up our clothes to keep our room neat and tidy.
quests.funFact: Hanging up your clothes can help them stay neat and ready to wear again!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to enjoy a story before it's time to sleep"?
quests.question: Read a Book
quests.hint: Pages, pictures, and a good story are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We read a book in the evening to relax before bedtime.
quests.funFact: Reading before bed can help your mind relax and get ready for sleep!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to place plates and spoons before a meal"?
quests.question: Set the Table
quests.hint: Plates, cups, and forks are placed down for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We set the table before dinner so everyone can sit and eat.
quests.funFact: Helping set the table is a simple way to help your family before a meal!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to travel to school on your own two feet"?
quests.question: Walk to School
quests.hint: You use your own two feet for this journey.
quests.explanation: Yes! We walk to school in the morning to get to our classroom.
quests.funFact: Walking to school is a fun way to get a little exercise before class begins!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to practice today's lesson a little more at home"?
quests.question: Do Homework
quests.hint: A pencil and a quiet space help with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We do homework in the afternoon to practice what we learned.
quests.funFact: Doing a little homework each day can help new lessons stick in your memory!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to put your playthings back where they belong"?
quests.question: Clean Up Toys
quests.hint: Toy bins or shelves are where these things end up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We clean up our toys after playtime to keep our room tidy.
quests.funFact: Putting toys away in the same spot each time makes them easy to find next time!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to travel to school on wheels with other students"?
quests.question: Ride the Bus
quests.hint: A big, often yellow vehicle carries you for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We ride the bus in the morning to get to school safely.
quests.funFact: School buses are often painted bright yellow so drivers can spot them easily!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to place your jacket on a hook or hanger"?
quests.question: Hang Up Clothes
quests.hint: This keeps your clothes neat instead of scattered on the floor.
quests.explanation: That's right! Hanging up clothes means using a hook or hanger to store them.
quests.funFact: A tidy closet makes it much easier to pick an outfit in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to hop aboard a big vehicle heading to class"?
quests.question: Ride the Bus
quests.hint: You share this ride with many other students.
quests.explanation: That's right! Riding the bus is one way many students travel to school.
quests.funFact: Riding the bus with friends is a fun way to start the school day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to get the table ready before everyone sits down to eat"?
quests.question: Set the Table
quests.hint: You do this right before a meal begins, not after.
quests.explanation: That's right! Setting the table means placing plates and forks before a meal.
quests.funFact: Some families like to fold napkins into fun shapes when setting the table!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Afternoon to finish the extra practice your teacher gave you"?
quests.question: Do Homework
quests.hint: Your teacher usually gives this to you to finish at home.
quests.explanation: That's right! Homework helps us remember our lessons a little longer.
quests.funFact: Finding a quiet, comfy spot can make homework time easier to focus on!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to turn the pages of a favorite story"?
quests.question: Read a Book
quests.hint: This is a calm, quiet activity, often done before bed.
quests.explanation: That's right! Reading a story is a calm way to end the day.
quests.funFact: Some children love hearing the very same favorite story again and again!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to flip the switch before you close your eyes"?
quests.question: Turn Off the Light
quests.hint: Your room becomes dark and cozy right after this happens.
quests.explanation: That's right! Turning off the light helps our room get dark for bedtime.
quests.funFact: Some children like a soft night light to keep a little glow in the dark!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to tidy up after a fun afternoon of play"?
quests.question: Clean Up Toys
quests.hint: You do this after playtime is finished, before dinner or bed.
quests.explanation: That's right! Cleaning up toys means putting playthings back where they belong.
quests.funFact: A tidy playroom gives you more space to run, build, and play!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to step outside and head toward your classroom"?
quests.question: Walk to School
quests.hint: You do this after breakfast, on the way to your classroom.
quests.explanation: That's right! Walking to school is a great way to start the day.
quests.funFact: Looking both ways before crossing the street keeps you safe on your walk!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Midday to refuel with a tasty meal at school or home"?
quests.question: Eat Lunch
quests.hint: A sandwich, some fruit, or a lunchbox are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Lunch gives us energy for the rest of our busy day.
quests.funFact: Eating a balanced lunch can help you stay focused for your afternoon classes!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to change out of pajamas and into daytime clothes"?
quests.question: Get Dressed
quests.hint: You pick a shirt, pants, and maybe a favorite pair of socks.
quests.explanation: Correct! We choose our clothes and get dressed every single morning.
quests.funFact: Many schools have a favorite color or uniform that students wear when they get dressed!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to keep your clothes tidy instead of leaving them out"?
quests.question: Hang Up Clothes
quests.hint: You do this after you change out of your daytime clothes.
quests.explanation: Well done! A tidy closet starts with hanging up our clothes.
quests.funFact: Hanging up your clothes can help them stay neat and ready to wear again!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to sit with classmates on the way to school"?
quests.question: Ride the Bus
quests.hint: You wait at a special stop before this begins.
quests.explanation: Well done! The bus carries lots of students to school together.
quests.funFact: School buses are often painted bright yellow so drivers can spot them easily!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to relax quietly with a good book"?
quests.question: Read a Book
quests.hint: You might do this snuggled up with a favorite stuffed animal.
quests.explanation: Well done! A good book can help us feel calm and sleepy before bed.
quests.funFact: Reading before bed can help your mind relax and get ready for sleep!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to sit down and complete your school assignments"?
quests.question: Do Homework
quests.hint: This helps you practice what you learned that day in class.
quests.explanation: Well done! Finishing homework helps us feel ready for the next school day.
quests.funFact: Doing a little homework each day can help new lessons stick in your memory!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to arrange forks and napkins before dinner starts"?
quests.question: Set the Table
quests.hint: It helps get everyone ready to sit down and eat together.
quests.explanation: Well done! Helping set the table is a great way to help your family.
quests.funFact: Helping set the table is a simple way to help your family before a meal!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to dim your room right before you fall asleep"?
quests.question: Turn Off the Light
quests.hint: This is one of the very last things you do before sleep.
quests.explanation: Well done! A dark, quiet room helps us fall asleep more easily.
quests.funFact: A dark room can help your body understand that it's time to sleep!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Night to whisper sweet dreams to your family"?
quests.question: Say Good Night
quests.hint: It's a warm, kind way to end the whole day.
quests.explanation: Correct! Saying good night helps everyone feel cozy before falling asleep.
quests.funFact: Families all around the world have their own special way of saying good night!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to close your eyes after a long, fun day"?
quests.question: Go to Bed
quests.hint: Your eyes get heavy and sleepy right before this happens.
quests.explanation: Correct! We go to bed at night so we can wake up ready for a new day.
quests.funFact: Most children need about ten to twelve hours of sleep every single night!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to cover your feet before you head outside"?
quests.question: Put on Shoes
quests.hint: Laces, velcro, or buckles help keep these snug on your feet.
quests.explanation: That's right! Shoes protect our feet for walking, running, and playing.
quests.funFact: Velcro shoes were invented to help little hands get ready all by themselves!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to make your way to school before the bell rings"?
quests.question: Walk to School
quests.hint: Holding a grown-up's hand can help keep you safe during this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Walking to school helps wake up our bodies before class.
quests.funFact: Walking to school is a fun way to get a little exercise before class begins!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to gather your toys and put them away neatly"?
quests.question: Clean Up Toys
quests.hint: It leaves your floor clear and your room looking tidy.
quests.explanation: Well done! A tidy playroom is ready for more fun tomorrow.
quests.funFact: Putting toys away in the same spot each time makes them easy to find next time!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to enjoy a small, tasty bite between meals"?
quests.question: Eat a Snack
quests.hint: Fruit, crackers, or cheese are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! A snack is a small, tasty bite between meals.
quests.funFact: Fruits like apples and grapes make a healthy and tasty afternoon snack!
